'''Shield''' acts as an ''extension'' of the player's [[Hull|hull]].

It serves to protect the hull from incoming damage. Though, ignored by [[File:AttackPiercing.png|link=|18px]] '''Piercing''' attacks, [[File:Heat.png|link=|18px]][[File:Corrode.png|link=|18px]] [[Status|'''status effects''']], and [[File:EnvHazard.png|link=|18px]] '''cards'''.

__TOC__ <!-- just for force it as of now, until more sections get added -->

== Shield ==

[[File:Shield.png|18px]] '''Shield''' is indicated by a blue segmented bar to the right of the hull. Enemy ships telegraph intent of raising their shields.

Player shield is ''retained'' between turns, but ''not'' between combats. However, [[File:ShieldMemory.png|link=|18px]]'''[[Shield Memory]]''' allows for this to happen.

== Max Shield ==

Shield is capped by [[File:MaxShield.png|18px]] '''Max Shield'''. Any shield gained when shield is at max is wasted.

== Temp Shield ==

[[File:TempShield.png|18px]] '''Temp Shield''' is indicated by a pink segmented bar appended to the Shield. It acts similarly to shields, but as the name implies, it is temporary and last only a single turn.

It works independently from Shields and is therefore ''not'' capped by Max Shield.

[[File:TimeStop.png|link=|18px]] '''[[Time Stop]]''' allows remaining Temp Shields to carry over next turn.
